image_description: An outdoor concrete staircase leading up to a modern, brutalist-style building with dark cladding. The stairs are flanked by metal handrails (bannisters) on both sides. The left side features a more complex railing system with vertical supports and a curved top rail, while the right side has a simpler tubular metal handrail supported by thin posts. The background includes a grassy slope and trees under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal railings clearly follow the diagonal incline of the concrete steps on both the left and right sides.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there is a continuous handrail, the supports are not 'evenly spaced balusters' in the traditional sense. The right side uses thin, sparse posts. The left side has a mix of vertical bars and angled supports that are not strictly evenly spaced or uniform cylindrical balusters as described in the taxonomy prior.
